description: The Portal's file clearance (portal/src/lib/auth/file-clearance.ts@790256c) on captured SharePoint files: one GET-only metadata-only capture run of the live-check scope (integrations/capture_sharepoint.py read_content=False: metadata, item permissions and eTags, no content GET) into the check's temporary state, each library classified before it is walked (a library named Finance, Business Central or Staff Scratch that the scope does not classify is refused), each captured file's DocumentCategory column read GET-only: per library whose whole drive the audience covers, the drive's list items in pages of 200 (graph.drive_list_items, fields and driveItem id/eTag; listitem_pages_read counts the pages), a row bound only to the captured file with the same item id and eTag, behind the reader's drive gate (integrations/graph_read.py SharePointReader.library_item_fields), and any file the pages leave unbound read per file (SharePointReader.list_item_fields), counted in listitem_fallbacks by why the library read left it (grant_narrower, unbound, page_cap, budget_cut or the read's typed refusal); a file left unread is never classified and is counted in listitem_failures by typed cause, its security class resolved as the employee gate resolves it (operating/doc_metadata_taxonomy.py file_security_class: library class from the capture and the policy, Staff Scratch folder, the Portal routing table's Finance categories), then three synthetic employees resolved by the real resolver (operating/employee_permissions.py): an ADMIN of Operations, a Finance STAFF member whose Portal membership confirms Finance, and a STAFF member whose Entra department says Finance but whose Portal membership (app_user_department_membership) is not confirmed. Every file not open to all staff (FINANCE, BUSINESS_CENTRAL, someone's SCRATCH, UNRESOLVED) must be refused to the uncleared and the unconfirmed one, and every FINANCE file served to the cleared one. Output: counts and class names only (never a name, path, id or column value). Needs MICROSOFT_GRAPH_TENANT_ID, MICROSOFT_GRAPH_CLIENT_ID, MICROSOFT_GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET and SHAREPOINT_SITE_ID. Read-only: GET only, token POST only. Until a live-check result exists this check is live-unverified.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check runs it; its test runs this module over the in-process FakeDrive with injected listItem columns (operating/tests/test_employee_permissions.py FileClearanceTests, evidence label injected-transport). The scope is the live-check scope (QCQA '/AOs/2026 - AOs' and the AGENTS use-case folder), which may hold no Finance file: class_counts.FINANCE = 0 is a valid result, and restricted_visible_to_uncleared = restricted_visible_to_unconfirmed = 0 then proves only the gate's shape on real records. The capture now reads each named target's library name GET-only (graph.drive) and refuses an unclassified restricted library; the estate scope (integrations/sharepoint_estate_scope.json) also keeps DocumentCategory per version (list_item_columns), which this check still reads live for its own scope. The synthetic employees are never real users. File clearance comes from the Portal's app_user_department_membership (the reporting API does not serve it: services/workbench-api/manifest/allowlist.json@12db891), carried by the Portal access snapshot; the Entra department only narrows it, so the unconfirmed employee must clear nothing.
